name: cove-tarot-companion
title_zh: 本地塔罗仪式：抽牌、回看与陪伴对话的邀请
tagline_zh: 想要一场不联网的塔罗仪式？抽一张牌，回看当初的解读，或在陪伴对话中自然邀请。适合独处、写作、或深夜自省。
tagline_en: Need an offline tarot ritual? Draw a card, revisit past readings, or invite one naturally in companion chats. For.
desc_en: Use when a user wants a local Tarot Ritual, returns from one to discuss its original reading, or a companion conversation offers a suitable moment to invite them. Requires an existing local shell and browser; not for independently drawing or reinterpreting cards.
why_zh: 它不重新解读，而是把仪式感做足：本地运行、尊重原意，只在对话缝隙里递出邀请，像一位懂分寸的牌友。
why_en: It doesn't reinterpret—it honors the ritual: runs locally, respects original meanings, and slips invitations into conversation.
limit_zh: 需要已有本地 shell 和浏览器环境；不能独立抽牌或重新解读，只负责仪式流程与邀请。若没有现成对话上下文。
limit_en: Requires existing local shell & browser; cannot draw or reinterpret independently—only orchestrates ritual and invites. Won't start without a.
title_en: Local Tarot Ritual: Draw, Revisit, and Invite
